provenance.interaction_definition: epsilon = genetic-interaction score = double-mutant fitness minus the expected (multiplicative) product of the two single-mutant fitnesses (Costanzo et al. 2016). Negative=aggravating/synthetic-sick-lethal, positive=alleviating/suppressive.
provenance.filter: |epsilon| > 0.120 AND p < 0.050 (pairwise); |epsilon| > 0.120 only (matrix has no p-value)
